description: Return sanitized read-only details for a domain in the authenticated EnCirca account. Use for private account status and expiration details, not as a public registration lookup or proof that a different visitor owns a domain. Auth codes and contact records are never returned. An expiration date alone does not establish the billing date, auto-renewal setting, renewal price, or payment status.

partner_id.description: ESB partner id. Optional if ENCIRCA_MCP_DEFAULT_PARTNER_ID is set.

name: get_domain_details
